reasoning.note: The conversational orchestrator. Haiku by the 2026-08-16 routing decision, which kept a single cloud model rather than adding a local classification hop per utterance.

fast.note: OpenClaw agents.defaults.utilityModel. Local, so genuinely free rather than unpriced.

vision.note: Declared and unassigned. ORION performs no vision inference today; CameraPresence is a presence signal, not a model call. A role invented to look complete would be worse than an honest gap.

local.note: LocalModel.defaultModel in the Swift app. Drives DistractionReasoner, NarrativeWriter and MorningBrief. Text transform, never an agent -- see LocalModel.swift for why.

embedding.note: OpenClaw agents.defaults.memorySearch. Backs selective recall over sessions and memory.

coder.note: Coding lane for scripts/orion-code. CORRECTS the 2026-09-06 note claiming the Qwens 'never answered' -- they did; num_predict was 900 and they spent it all thinking. A measurement bug, not a model failure. Re-measured 2026-09-07 at 6000+: qwen3.6:27b 48-61s (thinking off), gpt-oss:20b 58s, qwen3:30b 198s, all correct. 27b is primary: same 262144 context as the 30b, richer embedding, no thinking tax. Full account in PHASE_GOVERNED_SELF_DEVELOPMENT.md.

stt.note: Flux v2 streaming turn detection; EndOfTurn finalizes, Apple speech remains fallback.

tts.note: orion_tts_daemon.py with ORION_TTS_ENGINE=auto. Local first; the cloud voice is the fallback, not the default.

local_deep.note: Offline long-form reasoning. Measured 2026-09-07: 198s and 14999 thinking tokens to write a function the 27b wrote in 48s -- too slow to be a default, and exactly what you want when there is no network and the problem is hard. Same 262144 context as the coder role.

unrestricted.note: Declared and UNASSIGNED. Nick asked for a model that speaks without hedging; none is installed and picking one is his call, not this file's. Assign a local id here and it is reachable -- nothing else changes. The rule it inherits is the one personalities already enforce: unrestricted SPEECH, never unrestricted capability. It gets no tier, no tool and no root that Main does not have.
